title: The best adventure modpack I have ever made! (TBAMHEM!)
description: My attempt at making the best adventure themed modpack!
body:
**This is the best adventure modpack I have ever made! I'm not planning on updating it, but I might. I added 40+ mods to modify the feel of the game; the others are just library and optimization mods. It might be a bit buggy. I hope you enjoy it!**

# Features
- Minimap
- World Map
- Voice Chat
- Sound Physics
- Biomes
- Nature's Compass (Used to locate biomes)
- Waystones (Used to set waypoints where you can teleport back to)
- New Structures
- Backpacks
- New World Generation
- HUD Effects
- New Items
- Villager Names
- New Mobs
- Starter Kit
- Explorer's Compass (Used to locate structures)
- The Ability to Revive Your Friends in Hardcore (If you get there in time)
- New Particles And Sound Effects
- Mob Self Feeding
- Sparse Structures
- Illager Invasion
- Custom Emote Creator
- Dynamic Lights
- Spawn Animations
- The Ability to Sit on Slabs And Stairs
- Reworked End Dimension
- Farmer's Delight + More
- Forgiving Void Mod
- Frostiful Mod
- Better Nether Maps
- More Storage Systems
# Reasons why you should download this!
1. You can install it on a server!
2. It's perfect for a long-term world.
3. It is really fun!
4. Runs very smoothly!
